messages:
Anna: Quick alignment: final GA acceptance checklist for private deployments (VPC/on-prem). Need clear, testable gates.
Mike: Customers care most about preserved egress IPs and safe rollback.
Jia: Propose three scoped lanes: egress IP pinning, in-place upgrade+rollback, customer-managed peering/NAT.
Samir: Gate examples: installer --dry-run prints planned iptables/K8s egress rules; verify requested static IPs are applied.
NetOps Bot: deploy-checker: dry_run_ok == true && static_ips_present == true.
Lucy: ACME feedback: require outbound IP preservation during cutovers; fallback to hosted-proxy if peering fails is desirable.
Anna: Fallback = soft gate (documented). Hard gate = no unexpected public egress without opt-in.
Mike: Rollback test sketch: inject failure at T+30s, expect traffic back to previous revision within 120s, error delta <0.5%.
Jia: Also validate KV cache compatibility or provide eviction/migration path.
Acme NetOps: We need deterministic IPs and a dry-run mode to validate peering smoke.
Lucy: Include sample customer config in templates (mode: customer_vpc, pin_static_ips, installer.dry_run).
Mike: Security gate: certificate rotation must be doable without pod restarts. Add zero-downtime cert rollout test.
Anna: Draft GA gates: 1) Egress pinning for AWS/GCP; 2) installer --dry-run + human plan; 3) in-place upgrade+rollback E2E validated; 4) KMS + audit logs; 5) hosted-proxy fallback documented (soft).
Samir: Risk: on-prem variance high. Need compatibility matrix and list of unsupported combos.
Mike: Next steps: I'll PR the one-pager, Jia will write the E2E recipe, Samir drafts matrix. Review by Fri?
Jia: Can review Thu morning.
Acme NetOps: We'll run dry-run on staging peering next week and report.
Anna: If no objections, I'll lock these as working acceptance criteria tomorrow.
Samir: :white_check_mark:
Lucy: :thumbsup:
